name: Ensign
overview: The biblical concept of an ensign symbolizes a visible standard or signal that calls people together and directs their attention to God's purposes. In Isaiah, the lifting up of an ensign serves as a summons to the nations and a gathering point for the scattered people of Israel, highlighting Christ as the root of Jesse who stands as an ensign for all peoples. Similarly, Psalms and Isaiah depict ensigns as rallying points amid conflict or as beacons on hills, emphasizing their role in divine guidance and protection. These passages collectively reveal that ensigns represent God's sovereign call and the hope of restoration through Christ.
